# Perplexity API Reference — captured 2026-08-07

Primary endpoint: POST /v1/agent — response generation with optional web search and reasoning.

Capabilities: web search with domain/date/recency filters; `fetch_url` tool; finance search; people
search; SANDBOX CODE EXECUTION; function calling with custom tools; multi-turn via
`previous_response_id`; SSE streaming and non-streaming; asynchronous background processing with
polling.

Advanced: **MCP integration** connecting external remote servers with tool discovery;
**Skills system** — built-in Office document creation (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) plus custom inline
skills; reasoning effort levels (minimal..max); JSON-schema structured output; token/cache accounting;
per-operation cost tracking.

Model selection: single model or fallback chain of up to 5; provider/model format
(e.g. openai/gpt-5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6); presets fast/low/medium/high/xhigh.

Streaming: 14+ event types with intermediate tool output visibility (search, fetch, finance, people,
sandbox, MCP).

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Endpoint surface unchanged vs the 2026-07-07 cache; the new Gateway API and the
hosted remote MCP server are tracked in perplexity_changelog.txt.
